item.title: NSU Athletics launches ‘Leave Your Mark’ year-end giving campaign
item.description: As the 2025 calendar year comes to an end, Northwestern State fans have a chance to make it a happy one for the Demons’ athletic department. The department announced its Leave Your Mark campaign, which carries a goal of raising $100,000 in donations from Demon supporters by Dec. 31. item.title: Natchitoches Parish Master Gardener class to begin March 3
item.description: The Natchitoches Parish Master Gardener Association will offer a new Master Gardener training class beginning March 3, 2026. The program is a required step for anyone interested in joining the local Master Gardener Association and will run for 12 weeks, with classes held once a week. The cost to participate is $150. Applications are available … Continue reading Natchitoches Parish Master Gardener class to begin March 3

item.description: Lakeview High School will host a FAFSA Night on Thursday, Dec. 18 from 3:30 p.m. to 5 p.m. to assist parents with completing the Free Application for Federal Student Aid for the 2026–2027 school year. item.title: Natchitoches Shooting Range offers history, modern facilities open to shooters of all levels
item.description: What many residents may not realize is that the Natchitoches Shooting Range sits on a site rich in local history. Long before it became a destination for shooting sports, the property was home to an outdoor theater that hosted the historical production “Louisiana Cavalier,” presented by the Louisiana Outdoor Drama Association in the 1970s. item.title: NRMC honors nurses with DAISY award nominations
item.description: Natchitoches Regional Medical Center is recognizing two of its nurses, Fawn Slaughter, RN in Med-Surg, and Amber Freeman, RN in ICU, as nominees for the DAISY Award. The national award honors nurses who demonstrate extraordinary clinical skill, compassion, and dedication to patients and families, often in moments that go unnoticed. item.title: LSMSA helps make the holidays brighter for local children
item.description: The Jaycees held their annual M*A*S*H. (Make a Smile Happen) toy drive on Dec. 13. The toy drive, a local holiday tradition for over 20 years, features volunteers in a tent outside a local business collecting donated new, unwrapped toys. The toys are then sorted and distributed to needy families throughout the local area. Over … Continue reading LSMSA helps make the holidays brighter for local children

item.title: Oil and Gas Leasing Activity Continues in Natchitoches Parish
item.description: Oil and gas exploration in Natchitoches Parish continues to accelerate, with over 50 new leases filed at the Parish Clerk of Court’s office since November 22, 2025. These latest filings push the year-to-date total to 380 leases recorded since January 1, 2025 reinforcing Natchitoches Parish’s expanding position within the Haynesville Shale region.
